import ctypes
import numpy as np

# Load the libraries
ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so', mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
gsl = ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so')

# Define the function prototype
gsl.gsl_sf_coulomb_wave_F_array.argtypes = [ctypes.c_double, ctypes.c_int, ctypes.c_double, ctypes.c_double, ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_double), ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_double)]
gsl.gsl_sf_coulomb_wave_F_array.restype = ctypes.c_int

def compute_coulomb_wave(lam_min, kmax, eta, x):
    fc_array = (ctypes.c_double * (kmax + 1))()
    F_exp = ctypes.c_double()
    status = gsl.gsl_sf_coulomb_wave_F_array(lam_min, kmax, eta, x, fc_array, ctypes.byref(F_exp))
    if status != 0:
        raise RuntimeError('GSL function call failed with status {}'.format(status))
    return np.array(fc_array), F_exp.value

def assert_test():
    # Test case 1
    lam_min = 0.0
    kmax = 5
    eta = 1.0
    x = 2.0
    fc_array, F_exp = compute_coulomb_wave(lam_min, kmax, eta, x)
    assert len(fc_array) == kmax + 1
    assert isinstance(F_exp, float)

    # Test case 2
    lam_min = 1.0

    x = 1.0
    fc_array, F_exp = compute_coulomb_wave(lam_min, kmax, eta, x)
    assert len(fc_array) == kmax + 1
    assert isinstance(F_exp, float)

    # Test case 3
    lam_min = 2.0
    kmax = 4
    eta = 0.0
    x = 0.5
    fc_array, F_exp = compute_coulomb_wave(lam_min, kmax, eta, x)
    assert len(fc_array) == kmax + 1
    assert isinstance(F_exp, float)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    assert_test()
